_comment: Written by scripts/econ/models.mjs (edit that, not this). Player models: fixed named modules (docs/parts-redesign.md). `legacy`: the family each legacy function migrates to.

models.name: Pip
models.description: The starter gun: four reliable amber shells a second, and no tricks. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Pip
guide.blurb: The reliable starter

models.name: Hammer
models.description: The breacher: one slow, armour-piercing slug at a steady rhythm. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Hammer
guide.blurb: The breacher

models.name: Twinlink
models.description: A paired autoloader turret: a rattling stream of sixteen rounds, then a pause to reload. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Twinlink
guide.blurb: Paired autoloader turret

models.name: Longbarrel
models.description: The sniper: it charges while you hold and fires itself at full, one telegraphed shot that picks a part off. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Longbarrel
guide.blurb: The sniper

models.name: Bastion
models.description: The ship-killer double tap: two huge, slow cannonballs you can dodge, then a long wait. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Bastion
guide.blurb: The ship-killer double tap

models.name: Rattler
models.description: The steady hose: a stream of small yellow shells at a fixed rhythm. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Rattler
guide.blurb: The steady hose

models.name: Chainsaw
models.description: The minigun: it spins up from four shots a second to sixteen while you hold the trigger, and is useless on a tap. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Chainsaw
guide.blurb: The minigun

models.name: Stinger
models.description: The marksman SMG: twelve accurate needles in a burst, then a pause to reload. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Stinger
guide.blurb: The marksman SMG

models.name: Burst
models.description: The sky-filler: a canister shell that bursts on its own near whatever it passes. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Burst
guide.blurb: The sky-filler

models.name: Cloudmaker
models.description: The wall you place: four shells that burst where you aim, or sooner near a target, in wide clouds. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Cloudmaker
guide.blurb: The wall you place

models.name: Lobber
models.description: Artillery that lands where you click: one shell every second and a half, lobbed over everything to burst at your cursor (out to 2,640) in a 220 blast. Forty shells a crate. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Lobber
guide.blurb: Artillery that lands where you click

models.name: Quake
models.description: The walking barrage: a salvo of three shells every three seconds that land at 70%, 100% and 130% of your aim distance, a quarter second apart, each a 260 blast. It covers a lane, not a point. Uses three rounds a salvo. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Quake
guide.blurb: The walking barrage

models.name: Glint
models.description: The base pulse laser: charged pulses that reach far. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Glint
guide.blurb: The base pulse laser

models.name: Cutter
models.description: Close and brutal: a short, searing beam. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Cutter
guide.blurb: Close and brutal

models.name: Searchlight
models.description: A beam that reaches out further than anything. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Searchlight
guide.blurb: A beam that reaches out further than anything

models.name: Strobe
models.description: The base pulse gun: bursts that strip shields. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Strobe
guide.blurb: The base pulse gun

models.name: Overpulse
models.description: Four-shot bursts that tear shields down and barely scratch a hull. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Overpulse
guide.blurb: Four-shot bursts that tear shields down and barely scratch a hull

models.name: Dart
models.description: Lock and forget: a missile every couple of seconds that homes on the ship nearest your cursor, 30 damage and a 120 blast. Twenty-four missiles a crate. Point defence kills it in one hit. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Dart
guide.blurb: Lock and forget

models.name: Swarm
models.description: The ripple that floods point defence: six small rockets in half a second, every three seconds, spreading and then converging on the ship nearest your cursor. Each is 10 damage and a 60 blast and dies to one point-defence hit. Uses six rounds a salvo. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Swarm
guide.blurb: The ripple that floods point defence

models.name: Hammerhead
models.description: The steered warhead: a slow, heavy missile, 105 damage and a 150 blast. While you hold fire it flies toward your cursor; let go and it flies straight. Point defence needs two hits. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Hammerhead
guide.blurb: The steered warhead

models.name: Needle
models.description: The cheap rail: a long thin slug that goes through two ships. It fires slugs from the hold and needs no power. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Needle
guide.blurb: The cheap rail

models.name: Coilgun
models.description: The rail shotgun: five slugs in a tight cone, a finisher for close range that is spent past 2,700. It throws its own slugs for 14 E a shot, so it needs no ammo. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Coilgun
guide.blurb: The rail shotgun

models.name: Spear
models.description: The capital rail: one slug every couple of seconds that goes through three ships at full damage, a ring of shock at each. It costs 120 E a shot and needs no ammo. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Spear
guide.blurb: The capital rail

models.name: Hush
models.description: The base EMP: shuts a ship down for a moment. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Hush
guide.blurb: The base EMP

models.name: Blackout
models.description: A wide, long blackout. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Blackout
guide.blurb: A wide, long blackout

models.name: Spark
models.description: The base arc projector: lightning that jumps between ships. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Spark
guide.blurb: The base arc projector

models.name: Tesla
models.description: Lightning that jumps two ships further. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Tesla
guide.blurb: Lightning that jumps two ships further

models.name: Eel
models.description: The stalker: a slow, fat torpedo that creeps after its prey, 420 damage straight through shields and a 90 blast. Six torpedoes a crate, one every four seconds. Point defence needs three hits. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Eel
guide.blurb: The stalker

models.name: Leviathan
models.description: The fight-ender: a huge torpedo, 1,000 damage straight through shields and a 200 blast, one every six seconds. It flies straight and does not home, and arms a second after launch. Two rounds a shot (three shots a crate). Point defence needs five hits. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Leviathan
guide.blurb: The fight-ender

models.name: Lance
models.description: The held beam: a heavy lance that burns as long as the power lasts. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Lance
guide.blurb: The held beam

models.name: Rustjaw's Hive
models.description: Legendary. Looses a swarm of four small seeker missiles at whatever is nearest your cursor. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Frostbite Lance
models.description: Legendary. A freezing beam: the ship it touches is slowed, its thrust and turning cut while lit and a moment after. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Cinder Bloom
models.description: Legendary. Incendiary shells: the part they hit keeps burning, and so do its neighbours. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Prism Splitter
models.description: Legendary. A crystal bolt that shatters into a fan of shards when it hits. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Phase Cannon
models.description: Legendary. A slow, heavy round that passes clean through ships, hitting each one at full force. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Singularity Launcher
models.description: Legendary. Fires a collapsing star that drags nearby ships in, then implodes. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Ion Drive
models.description: Efficient and steady, with a low top speed.

guide.name: Ion Drive
guide.blurb: Efficient and steady, with a low top speed

models.name: Vernier
models.description: A cheap little thruster for corner push. It has no boost: boosting gives it no extra thrust and no extra drain.

guide.name: Vernier
guide.blurb: A cheap little thruster for corner push. It has no boost: boosting gives it no extra thrust and no extra drain

models.name: Afterburner
models.description: Weak at cruise, a huge burst when boosting. Best with a Drive Cell touching it.

guide.name: Afterburner
guide.blurb: Weak at cruise, a huge burst when boosting. Best with a Drive Cell touching it

models.name: Torch
models.description: Brutal thrust at full power all the time, and a brutal drain. It has no boost: nothing is held back to give.

guide.name: Torch
guide.blurb: Brutal thrust at full power all the time, and a brutal drain. It has no boost: nothing is held back to give

models.name: Plasma Drive
models.description: The balanced main engine.

guide.name: Plasma Drive
guide.blurb: The balanced main engine

models.name: Drift Sail
models.description: Near-free cruising, never in a hurry.

guide.name: Drift Sail
guide.blurb: Near-free cruising, never in a hurry

models.name: Fusion Torch
models.description: The long-haul racer: fast, and faster still.

guide.name: Fusion Torch
guide.blurb: The long-haul racer: fast, and faster still

models.name: Cell Reactor
models.description: The starter generator. It explodes when destroyed.

guide.name: Cell Reactor
guide.blurb: The starter generator

models.name: Isotope Pile
models.description: A weak generator, but tough, and it never explodes.

guide.name: Isotope Pile
guide.blurb: A weak generator, but tough, and it never explodes

models.name: Fusion Plant
models.description: A heavy plant with plenty of power, and a big blast.

guide.name: Fusion Plant
guide.blurb: A heavy plant with plenty of power, and a big blast

models.name: Overclock Reactor
models.description: The most power for its size: fragile, and the biggest blast.

guide.name: Overclock Reactor
guide.blurb: The most power for its size

models.name: Battery
models.description: Adds to the ship's pool on a powered network: holds 200 and gives it quickly.

guide.name: Battery
guide.blurb: Adds to the ship's pool on a powered network

models.name: Capacitor
models.description: Touching Capacitors form a bank that feeds the guns, beams, miners and Flash Screen it touches before the ship does; it does not feed engines.

guide.name: Capacitor
guide.blurb: Touching Capacitors form a bank that feeds the guns, beams, miners and Flash Screen it touches before the ship does; it does not feed engines

models.name: Drive Cell
models.description: Touching Drive Cells form a bank that feeds the engines and Burst Strafers it touches before the ship does; it does not feed guns.

guide.name: Drive Cell
guide.blurb: Touching Drive Cells form a bank that feeds the engines and Burst Strafers it touches before the ship does; it does not feed guns

models.name: Heavy Bank
models.description: A deep, heavy battery for the ship's pool: holds a lot, but gives it slowly.

guide.name: Heavy Bank
guide.blurb: A deep, heavy battery for the ship's pool

models.name: Mining Laser
models.description: A pulsed cutter that takes ore from rock, and a poor weapon.

guide.name: Mining Laser
guide.blurb: A pulsed cutter that takes ore from rock, and a poor weapon

models.name: Bore
models.description: A heavy cutter that breaks harder rock than a mining laser.

guide.name: Bore
guide.blurb: A heavy cutter that breaks harder rock than a mining laser

models.name: Demolition Launcher
models.description: Fires mining charges (30 a crate, one every 2 seconds) that stick to rock, blink for a second, then blow it open. Harmless to ships. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Demolition Launcher
guide.blurb: Fires mining charges (30 a crate, one every 2 seconds) that stick to rock, blink for a second, then blow it open

models.name: Siphon
models.description: Drinks gas from gas pockets and sends it back to the ship.

guide.name: Siphon
guide.blurb: Drinks gas from gas pockets and sends it back to the ship

models.name: Scanner
models.description: A quick short sweep that reads rocks and finds seams.

guide.name: Scanner
guide.blurb: A quick short sweep that reads rocks and finds seams

models.name: Long-Range Array
models.description: A slow sweep that reaches twice as far as a scanner.

guide.name: Long-Range Array
guide.blurb: A slow sweep that reaches twice as far as a scanner

models.name: Constructor
models.description: Builds structures piece by piece.

guide.name: Constructor
guide.blurb: Builds structures piece by piece

models.name: Deflector
models.description: The standard shield, which soaks damage before the hull and refills 8 a second per cell after 3 seconds unhit.

guide.name: Deflector
guide.blurb: The standard shield, which soaks damage before the hull and refills 8 a second per cell after 3 seconds unhit

models.name: Flicker Screen
models.description: A thin, cheap shield that refills 20 a second per cell after only 1 second unhit.

guide.name: Flicker Screen
guide.blurb: A thin, cheap shield that refills 20 a second per cell after only 1 second unhit

models.name: Bulwark Projector
models.description: A deep shield that soaks an alpha strike but refills only 5 a second per cell after 4 seconds unhit.

guide.name: Bulwark Projector
guide.blurb: A deep shield that soaks an alpha strike but refills only 5 a second per cell after 4 seconds unhit

models.name: Jump Coil
models.description: More jump drive for a bigger hull.

guide.name: Jump Coil
guide.blurb: More jump drive for a bigger hull

models.name: Heavy Coil
models.description: A dense coil with more jump drive per cell that also cuts the jump cooldown by a fifth.

guide.name: Heavy Coil
guide.blurb: A dense coil with more jump drive per cell that also cuts the jump cooldown by a fifth

models.name: Reactive Armour
models.description: Plate that blunts small fast hits, so it beats streams of fire.

guide.name: Reactive Armour
guide.blurb: Plate that blunts small fast hits, so it beats streams of fire

models.name: Spaced Plating
models.description: Layered plate with room between that takes half damage from blasts.

guide.name: Spaced Plating
guide.blurb: Layered plate with room between that takes half damage from blasts

models.name: Pulse Dynamo
models.description: Puts 10 a second into each Capacitor or Drive Cell bank it touches, split evenly. It needs no wires and powers nothing itself.

guide.name: Pulse Dynamo
guide.blurb: Puts 10 a second into each Capacitor or Drive Cell bank it touches, split evenly

models.name: Flash Screen
models.description: A shield with no slow refill that returns whole 4 seconds after it breaks, or at once for 4 E a point from a Capacitor bank touching it.

guide.name: Flash Screen
guide.blurb: A shield with no slow refill that returns whole 4 seconds after it breaks, or at once for 4 E a point from a Capacitor bank touching it

models.name: Rail Driver
models.description: The semi-automatic rifle: a clip of six sharp shots at six a second, then it reloads itself in a second and a half for 48 E, from its bank first. It needs no ammo. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Rail Driver
guide.blurb: The semi-automatic rifle

models.name: Repair Beam
models.description: Mends 42 HP a second into the friendly part its beam lands on (range 520, 28 power a second, no heat): hold fire with it on a party member or an ally. It can't mend your own ship, a destroyed part or a shield, and does nothing to an enemy. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Repair Beam
guide.blurb: Mends 42 HP a second into the friendly part its beam lands on (range 520, 28 power a second, no heat)

models.name: Point Defence Turret
models.description: Shoots down incoming missiles, torpedoes, mortar shells and seekers on its own: 5 shots a second out to 560, 2 power a shot. One hit kills a missile, mortar shell or seeker; a Hammerhead takes 2, an Eel 3, a Leviathan 5. It never fires at ships, and a boss's rings of shots are yours to dodge. Turret: aims itself.

guide.name: Point Defence Turret
guide.blurb: Shoots down incoming missiles, torpedoes, mortar shells and seekers on its own

models.name: Burst Strafer
models.description: A dodge thruster: a hard fifth-of-a-second burst away from its nozzle, ready again in under half a second, and a lot of energy every time. Fit them facing different ways to dodge any way. It draws from a Drive Cell bank touching it first. No push at all for cruising.

guide.name: Burst Strafer
guide.blurb: A dodge thruster

models.name: Tow Beam
models.description: Latches onto a wreck, debris or a loot pod and drags it on a tether to a station to salvage, and never takes hold of a working ship.

guide.name: Tow Beam
guide.blurb: Latches onto a wreck, debris or a loot pod and drags it on a tether to a station to salvage, and never takes hold of a working ship
